name: Electronics
summary: Designing, building and testing electronic systems: analogue and digital electronics, programming, signal processing and control engineering, resting on a heavy foundation of mathematics and physics. You work with electric motors, sensors, power electronics and intelligent control, and with both the hardware and the software side. A small intake in a town built around electronics manufacturing.

family.name: Electronics
family.differs: 3 years, research-based and leading straight into the MSc; no internship. Quota 1 needs a 7.0 average.
